One check per doc category, per-variant overrides for kinds, visibilities, privacies, locations and tags; documented = the previous sibling is a `/** */` comment with text. Each check's `utils` name the kind predicates (function, method, accessor, constructor, top-level variable statement) and the documented test once. Accessors, constructors and static members are recognized by their `get`/`set`/`static` keyword tokens and the `constructor` name, not by a regex over the member text; a later declarator in a list is found through any run of comments after its comma (recursive utility). Shared bindings give TSLint's doc sharing: a get/set accessor inherits docs from a same-named accessor in the same body, and function/method overloads share docs with a same-named sibling unless `overloads: true`. Tag requirements are regexes over the comment text, not a JSDoc parse (jsdoc-parse). Raw: `types` (missing commas) and defaults/edge-case do not parse, and the negated relations make those files source-incomplete.
